source.note: JD_Comparison_SpecSheet.pdf, official deere.com product-comparison export (3 columns: 610-8ft/10ft/16ft), user-supplied, captured 2026-09-23; plus Brochures/Unsorted/JD_610 - 10 ft_SpecSheet.pdf and JD_610 - 20 ft_SpecSheet.pdf (individual single-model exports for those two widths). One field intentionally excluded from variants: 'Transport Width' shows '9.83-19.58 ft' identically across all 4 widths now checked (8/10/16/20ft) - confirms this is a static family-level attribute (converts to a round 3.0-6.0m in metric), not a per-width computed value. It describes the 610 family's overall transport-width span rather than any single variant - correctly left out of the per-width variants for that reason, not because it was a data error. Similarly, the 'Stabilizer Wheels' note text (constants.stabilizerWheels) is unchanged across all four widths and only ever mentions 8ft/16ft explicitly - also read as static family-level text, not evidence about the 20ft model specifically. 'Frame > Underframe Clearance' is populated only for the 8ft column and blank for 10ft/16ft in that section, though the same figures are given correctly per shank-type option further down under 'Standard Options' for all four widths - used that section instead, recorded in constants.shankOptions. Cross-checked against dsaa74466-field-prep-tools.pdf p.30 (Deere's full-line brochure spec table): confirms all shared constants exactly and confirms weight is genuinely unpublished by Deere for this model across all source formats checked (compare sheet, full-line brochure, single-model pages for 10ft and 20ft).
